description: Ptychopetalum olacoides extract (CAS 84929-46-4 ), derived from the Amazonian bark commonly known as Muira Puama, is a botanical extract sourced for use in nutritional and functional product development. It functions as a bioactive ingredient and flavoring component in supplement and food applications. In nutraceutical formulations, it is incorporated into capsules, tablets, and functional beverages targeting cognitive and vitality-focused product lines. Food and beverage manufacturers use it as a botanical flavoring agent to deliver a distinctive, earthy profile in specialty health drinks and herbal blends. Formulators in the dietary supplement sector also source it for its antioxidant activity. This extract is used to support oxidative stability in complex multi-ingredient products. Pharmaceutical and healthcare product developers incorporate it into standardized herbal preparations where consistent extract quality is a procurement requirement. Ptychopetalum olacoides extract is typically supplied as a dry powder or liquid extract, with dry forms being the most common for supplement manufacturing. Standardized grades are available for formulation consistency. These grades are often characterized by defined ratios or active constituent concentrations. Both food-grade and technical-grade specifications are offered depending on the intended application and regional regulatory framework.
